title: Messages
overview: This guide covers messages workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Messages (secure in-app collaboration)
subtasks.purpose: Send and receive secure messages with providers, caregivers and other practice staff, with a per-conversation Focused Vital Snapshot pulled from the selected patient.

steps.title: Open Messages
steps.description: Click Messages in the sidebar. The three-pane layout shows: Conversations (left), Thread pane (centre) and Focused Vital Snapshot (right).

steps.title: Search Conversations
steps.description: Use the Search conversations box at the top of the left pane to find an existing thread by participant or subject.

steps.title: Filter Message List
steps.description: Filter the list with the All | Unread | Flagged tabs above the conversation list.

steps.title: Open a Conversation
steps.description: Click a conversation to load its messages in the centre pane; empty state reads “Your Messages — Select a contact from the list or start a new conversation to collaborate.”

steps.title: Start New Thread
steps.description: To start a new thread, click the + (floating action button, bottom-left) — pick recipient(s), optionally attach a patient and type the message.

steps.title: Use Bulk Message Actions
steps.description: Use the ⋮ menu (top-right of the left pane) for bulk actions: mark all read, mute, archive.

steps.title: Attach Patient Vitals
steps.description: In the Focused Vital Snapshot pane, use Search patients by name or ID… to attach patient context; the panel then renders the patient’s latest BP / Glucose / Weight readings alongside the conversation.

steps.title: Flag or Mark Unread
steps.description: Use the flag / unread controls inside a message to change its state; flagged messages appear under the Flagged tab. Notes Messages are HIPAA-secured and stored inside the practice tenant; they are not sent as email. Attaching a patient to a conversation logs the reference to that patient’s audit trail. Unread counts on the Messages sidebar badge reflect only the current user’s inbox. Task 7.15 — Settings
